channel.title: BK Reader (The Brooklyn Reader) - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from BK Reader (The Brooklyn Reader) (bkreader.com)

item.title: The World Needs Artists. They Also Need All of Us.
item.description: Op-Ed: The velvet rope around theater keeps too many people from the stories that shape us.

item.title: Building Parent Power For Early Intervention in Brooklyn
item.description: United for Brownsville is a nonprofit that trains parents on how to advocate for their children amid the often lengthly and confusing early intervention process.

item.title: Girl Scouts Spread Love at Brooklyn Food Distribution
item.description: The Girl Scouts of Greater New York donated more than 30,000 boxes of Girl Scout Cookies to New Yorkers facing food insecurity.

item.title: Cleanup Plan Proposed for Contaminated Williamsburg Site Ahead of New Housing
item.description: City officials are accepting public comments through Mar. 3, 2026 on a proposed environmental cleanup tied to a planned residential development at 653 Grand Street.

item.title: Feb 14: Brooklyn Black History Maker, Chris Rock
item.description: Chris Rock has become one of the most successful and well-known stand-ups in modern comedy, earning him the moniker, “funniest man in America."

item.title: Medgar Evers President Elected Higher Ed Commissioner
item.description: Medgar Evers College President Dr. Patricia Ramsey was elected as commissioner of the Middle States Commission on Higher Education, with a term running through 2030.

item.title: Grand Street Settlement Opens New Head Start Center in Sunset Park
item.description: The nonprofit launches the Sunset Park West Child and Family Center, adding 96 child care seats and new jobs while addressing a major local child care shortage.

item.title: Feb 15: Brooklyn Black History Maker, Letitia James
item.description: Park Slope native Letitia James is the first woman of color to hold statewide office in New York and the first woman elected to the position of New York State Attorney General.

item.title: Kings County Hospital Opens Center to Treat Child Abuse And Trauma
item.description: NYC Health + Hospitals/Kings County opened the ACE Center in Brooklyn, offering trauma-informed evaluation, treatment and prevention services for children facing abuse or neglect.

item.title: Legal Aid Challenges USDA Over Denied SNAP Replacements
item.description: The Legal Aid Society and Freshfields US LLP filed a federal appeal seeking to restore SNAP benefits stolen through EBT skimming, challenging USDA policies that block replacements for low-income families.
